table_description: Fact table tracking inventory levels. Records quantity on hand for each item at each warehouse on a given date.
data_quality_notes: INV_DATE_SK joins to DATE_DIM — snapshot date
INV_QUANTITY_ON_HAND is the count at that point in time, not a delta
Granularity: one row per (date, item, warehouse) combination
Large table — always filter by date

key_columns.name: INV_DATE_SK
key_columns.description: FK to DATE_DIM — inventory snapshot date

key_columns.name: INV_QUANTITY_ON_HAND
key_columns.description: Units in stock at that point
